groups.heading: DevOps & Infrastructure
bullets: Owned release stability and incident triage across 25+ CI/CD pipelines and 20 microservices (Jenkins, Groovy, Python, Kubernetes, Helm), protecting the monthly customer upgrade image of an IAM platform serving 130M+ subscribers across 150+ integrated systems.
Cut performance-test report generation time by ~60% by replacing Selenium UI scraping with direct Grafana REST API calls in Python.
Cut manual release-reporting time ~80% with a multi-agent system that aggregates observability data from Grafana, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and logs into automated stability reports and visualizations.
Cut release-validation time ~97% by eliminating a redundant validation pipeline and consolidating its checks into the main release workflow.
Resolved customer-escalated and pipeline-blocking infrastructure issues — Kubernetes resource deadlocks, time-sync failures, rolling-upgrade CPU spikes — through systematic root-cause analysis.

groups.heading: Performance, Load & Stability Testing
bullets: Owned monthly stability and regression testing via 48-hour load runs, flagging 10% release-over-release regressions and routing them to microservice owners.
Benchmarked 20+ OAuth APIs and Kafka event pipelines (JMeter, Prometheus, Grafana) under controlled pod isolation: HPA capping, synthetic data, scaled dependencies.
Built internal CLI automation codifying performance- and stability-testing procedures and Jenkins workflows into reusable skill modules.
Led end-to-end planning and delivery of a mission-critical migration of a legacy enterprise VCS to Git, involving IT, QA, and senior VPs.
Rescued 20+ years of production source code — 200,000+ files across hundreds of repositories — from an unstable legacy VCS.

Built migration pipelines against the system's proprietary SDK to extract repository structure, history, tags, and permissions, with integrity validation ensuring lossless transfer of 700,000+ commits at scale.
Integrated the migrated repositories into Azure CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated build and deployment for the newly transferred codebase.
